scope: Independent development coupon. No cutting, endpoint, margin qualification, M5 pass, M6 or motion permit. No change to archived scenes, default physics or readers.
intervention: A relaxed signed tetrahedral-volume constraint on each transverse interior triangle hinge (across consecutive longitudinal cells); rest volume zero on the flat sheet. Per native solver iteration use 0.08 times the inverse-mass weighted PBD projection, before the unchanged guide. Both incident triangles must still have all structural edges live. No new spring, cuttable bond, label, pin, or guide. Not a calibrated material law.
acquisition: One fresh instance per arm of the pair. Same frozen outer_v5 origin/axes/grasps, validated optical ready joints, load sequence, pull per arm, step counts, native ECM work [3,0,0.080], primary [0,4.5,0.088] and alternative [-4.5,4.5,0.080]. Never move the cutter after setup, never command its jaws. One 70-degree loaded work and two 20-degree loaded reviews, all at the original closed ready pose. No endpoint-based action, retries or retuning.
guards: Original tension band and grasp minima, no RCM failure, drift beyond 0.5 mm, collision block, cut, release of seam support or tear. All 1219 structural constraints must be alive and identical within and between runs. Exact stock first RGB-D, camera, joints and nodes versus archived v5 first exposure. Pair all exposure times, camera transforms, intrinsics, joint and arm targets, load commands and steps. Nodes and edges for offline scoring only; damage and strain veto only.
mechanics_metric: At loaded work, project scoring nodes on the original sheet normal (mm). RMS of (2*h[j]-h[j-1]-h[j+1])/4 over j=6..11, columns 11,12. This removes constant and linear tilt and equals amplitude for a pure alternating mode. Require nonzero stock baseline and at least 25% lower RMS with bending. Report both columns and all three observations.
optical_metric: Only RGB-D, zero noise. On each narrow image count rows 6..10 independently certified INTACT by the frozen v5 strip reader; neither view may lose any previously certified row. At primary require the weakest row/side valid dominant bank-patch area among rows 6..10 to increase by at least 10% and at least one pixel. Report per-side areas, both measured station sets and marker/active work chart; require a valid paired work chart/marker and no loss of stock main-path work stations. This is uncut visibility at ready, not post-bite connectivity at the entrance.
overall: Only all checks together qualify this uncut screen. No trial runs before protocol, executable hashes and green versioned regressions are sealed. Stop on an acquisition fault; no replacement. No cross-cut claim from live uncut data: require separate Lua tests of dead incident faces, immobile pins, unchanged structural labels and independent halves after a full seam split before considering live physics.
